_comment: Demo member data. Synthetic — no real person appears here.
This file exists so that 'the same screen shows that person's own data once
real data arrives' is a data swap and not a rewrite. Until 2026-08-16 the
account, plan, coverage, clinics and every consent flag were inline
constants in app.html, which made that sentence false: swapping them meant
editing the screen. The shape below IS the contract the backend has to
return. app.html reads it and nothing else.
What is still faked, and cannot be fixed by a data swap: the Core AI call
behind a score, the payer gateway behind a balance, the network directory,
_policy_version: The consent policy text currently in force. A consent record granted under
an older version is NOT active — it shows as needing re-consent rather than
silently continuing. That is the whole reason consent is a list of records
and not a boolean: a boolean cannot express 'agreed, but to something we no

_balance: No annualMax / usedToDate on purpose. A remaining balance computed from
our own claim warehouse is wrong whenever a recent visit has not been
filed yet. The correct source is X12 270/271 and it does not exist yet.

_parties: The 834 gives names, dates of birth and relationships. It does not carry
contact details for family, which is why an adult family member is reached
through the employee rather than directly.

_note: Adult family, deliberately with no access row on this credential. The
'employee agrees for the family' checkbox is the most legally dangerous
shortcut available: it voids the basis for the spouse's data.
parties.name: Sam Reyes

_note: Consent for claims linking was given under the previous policy text.
It is not active, and the screen says so rather than treating it as on.
This is the case a boolean cannot represent.
